name: Hotel Amrut
area: Kodibag, beside Syndicate Bank, inner market road, Karwar
signature_dish: Karwari fish thali and prawn ghee roast
why_it_matters: An old Karwar seafood institution beside Syndicate Bank at Kodibag — a long-standing traditional fish restaurant ranked among the very top in town on Tripadvisor across 320-plus reviews. It is the address most associated with authentic Karwari seafood: spicy fish curries, ghee roasts and the catch of the day fried fresh.
insider_tip: Order the prawn ghee roast — the house signature — and the Karwari fish thali. The cooking runs spicy in the true Karwar style; say so if you want it milder. Has a full bar and rooms above. Cash and card both fine.
signature_address: Kodibag, beside Syndicate Bank, inner market road, Karwar, Uttara Kannada District, Karnataka 581301

name: Swetha Lunch Home
why_it_matters: Currently the top-ranked restaurant in Karwar on Tripadvisor (4.4/5 across 310-plus reviews) — a lunch home praised repeatedly for fresh fish, prompt service and value, with reviewers saying the traditional home cooking makes them forget they are away from home. The benchmark Karwari fish-thali address.
insider_tip: Go at lunch — it is a lunch home, and the fish thali is freshest then. The thali is the order: rice, fish curry, fried fish and solkadi. Excellent value; expect it to be busy and home-style rather than fancy.
signature_address: Karwar town, Uttara Kannada District, Karnataka 581301

name: Parvati Fish Land
why_it_matters: A Tripadvisor-listed seafood restaurant in Karwar town noted as a super-affordable option for fresh fish — the budget-friendly counterpart to the better-known lunch homes. A practical anchor for travellers who want a no-frills coastal meal without the higher price of the seafood institutions.
insider_tip: Good when you want fresh Karwari seafood at the lowest price — ask what came in that day and have it fried. No-frills; cash-friendly.
signature_address: Karwar town, Uttara Kannada District, Karnataka 581301

name: Hotel Bhadra
area: Kaiga Road, near Kali Bridge, Karwar
signature_dish: Prawn sukka — prawns with roasted coconut, garlic and curry leaves
why_it_matters: A seafood restaurant near the Kali Bridge on Kaiga Road, singled out by food guides for its prawn sukka — prawns tossed with roasted coconut, garlic, red chillies and curry leaves, a coastal Konkan-Karwar speciality. The local pick for that dish in particular.
insider_tip: Order the prawn sukka — the dry, coconut-roasted preparation it is known for, distinct from the gravied dishes elsewhere in town. It sits near the Kali Bridge, easy to combine with a Kali river stop.
signature_address: Kaiga Road, near Kali Bridge, Karwar, Uttara Kannada District, Karnataka 581301

name: Rasa at Sterling Karwar
area: Sterling Karwar resort, near Devbagh, Karwar
signature_dish: Tisrya sukke (clam dry curry) and Bhindi solkadi
why_it_matters: The in-house restaurant of Sterling Karwar, where the kitchen sources from local suppliers and the chef cooks regional Konkan-Karwar dishes — tisrya sukke (clam dry curry), bhindi solkadi — that food writers rate as good as the best places in town. The comfortable, full-service option for trying Karwari coastal cooking.
insider_tip: Ask for the regional Konkan plates rather than the resort's all-purpose menu — the tisrya sukke and solkadi dishes are the reason it is worth a visit. Reserve ahead if you are not staying at the resort.
signature_address: Sterling Karwar resort, near Devbagh, Karwar, Uttara Kannada District, Karnataka 581301
